title: A Closer Look at Language Model Introspection: Probing Information and Reporting
abstract: arXiv:2611.15267v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: One way to study language-model introspection is to test whether models can identify where their activations have been perturbed. We train a simple linear classifier to identify the perturbed sentence from the model's activations, then compare its predictions with the model's own answers across pretraining and injection strengths. This tests whether the model is being asked to report information that is already easy to recover. If so, successful localization may be less demanding than it first appears and may not extend to the broader uses that motivate introspection research, such as faithfully explaining a model's reasoning or helping researchers assess the reliability of its answers. translated_title: 深入审视语言模型内省：探测信息与报告
translated_abstract: 研究语言模型内省的一种方法是测试模型能否识别其激活值在何处受到扰动。我们训练一个简单的线性分类器，从模型的激活值中识别被扰动的句子，然后将其预测与模型自身的回答在不同预训练阶段和注入强度下进行比较。这实际上检验的是：模型被要求报告的信息是否本身就已经容易被恢复。如果是这样，那么成功的定位任务可能比表面上看起来要求更低，并且可能无法推广到激发内省研究的更广泛用途上，例如忠实地解释模型的推理过程，或帮助研究者评估其回答的可靠性。在 OLMo 3 32B 模型上，当在第 0 层注入四倍于典型激活范数的扰动、并在第 24 层进行探测读取时，监督式探测分类器在 84 亿训练 token 后达到 98.3% 的准确率，而模型的零样本回答仍停留在随机水平（11.1%）。
tldr: 该研究通过对比线性探测分类器与模型自身的零样本回答发现：在激活扰动定位任务中，探测分类器能轻松达到 98.3% 的准确率而模型报告仍处于随机水平，表明语言模型内省的表现可能主要源于报告易于线性恢复的信息，而非真正的自我反思能力。
en_tdlr: This study compares a linear probe with the model's zero-shot answers on an activation-perturbation localization task, showing that the probe easily achieves 98.3% accuracy while the model's self-report remains at chance, suggesting that language model introspection may largely reflect reporting of easily recoverable information rather than genuine self-reflection.
